description: Christmas campaign section: neon animated tree intro, three-column info block, and a closing Santa/contact strip.

intro.default:
This Christmas, we’re turning up the glitter, glamour and festive fabulousness at The Black Cap, Camden!

Get ready for a Christmas celebration that’s bigger, campier and merrier than ever, with festive sparkle, Christmas cheer and enough tinsel to make Santa jealous.

Whether you’re planning a Christmas party, festive get-together, Christmas drinks or the ultimate Christmas night out, this is where your Christmas celebrations come to life.

closeHeadline.default: Make this Christmas extra. Make it fabulous. Make it Black Cap.
